course.title: Cairn — YouTube Course Tracker & Study Assistant

subject.note: This knowledge base documents the Cairn extension itself, not a course taught through it. It has no lectures, transcripts, or slide decks.

caveats: Scope is user-facing only by design: no server architecture, API surface, database schema, or unshipped features are documented.
Describes version 1.3.0. Limits, defaults and UI labels are version-specific and will drift as the extension is updated.
Model catalogs and default models come from providers that change them independently of Cairn releases.

Authorship and the Death Stranding inspiration come from Cairn's maker directly rather than from a published page. The model recommendation is dated 2026-08-26 and is explicitly not a standing one: the prices and prompt-caching behaviour behind it were checked that day against DeepSeek's pricing page, Anthropic's and OpenRouter's caching docs, and the source of the pi-ai provider library, and providers change all of it independently of Cairn's releases. Re-verify before quoting it as current.
